_readme: External tool dependencies. Nothing under tools/vendor/ except this manifest, bootstrap.py, and .gitignore is committed — installs live in gitignored subdirectories. Resolve or install via: python tools/vendor/bootstrap.py <name> [--install]

blender.purpose: atelier 3D backend — sculpt (metaballs/mesh), stage (constraints), frame (camera), G-buffer (passes/Cryptomatte/AOVs). Driven headless: blender --background --python <script>
